summary: Public projects created on 5 April 2026: 12 repos.
intro: AI decision-making, geopolitical simulation, synthetic societies and multi-perspective exploration appear across several repositories, alongside personal AI, memory and context tooling. Other work covers Hebrew calendar resources, an LLM request-for-proposal tool, MCP aggregation notes, repo starter templates and sample whiteboards for diagram cleaning.
